title: 영어브리핑_2026-10-25
korean_summary: 일요일 브리핑: 주간 돌아보기(9월 결산·Asanka 비자·태풍 대비 4건·GOH 고정팀 단가·기계임대), 월요일 마감 5건(화목 보고, 조키펌프 견적 만료, Hao 2건 답, Mai 방수포 견적, Trinh GOH 의견), 오늘 표현 8개, Hao와의 월요일 대화 역할극.
paragraphs: Good morning, Anthony. Today is Sunday, October twenty-fifth. This is a short Sunday briefing. No new work today. We look back at the week, look ahead to Monday, and practice English.
This briefing has five parts. First, the week in review. Second, what Monday looks like. Third, today's new expressions. Fourth, a short role-play. Then a closing.
Please listen slowly. When you hear a pause, say the sentence out loud. Let's begin.
Part one. The week in review.
This week you closed the September accounts. The profit and loss report, the estimate for head office, the debit file, and the big data analysis are all done.
You started the visa process for Asanka, the new sewing manager. He sent his passport copy. You asked him for a photo for the e-visa, and for his departure date.

You handled the typhoon preparation. On Saturday you gave four clear tasks. Mr Mai repairs the four leaking points and sends photos. Ms Trinh gets the repair date from the landlord. Ms An reports the approval status of the PR. Mai sends the new tarpaulin quotation by Monday.

You moved the GOH loading issue one step forward. The EXIM team owns the sheet. HR Tho asked the labor company about a fixed team. The supplier wants a higher price, so you asked for a rate per GOH box, not a daily rate.
And you reviewed the machine rental list for November. You tidied up the file yourself, and you gave Hao a clear format for next month.
Part two. Monday, October twenty-sixth.
Here are the items that are due on Monday.
Number one. The weekly firewood report to Chloe Kim. It is on your calendar.
Number two. The jockey pump quote expires on Monday. Check that the e-approval is done.

Number three. Hao owes you two answers by Monday morning. Why three computer sewing machines, and the price per unit. And the return dates for the waistband machine and the chain double needle machine.
Number four. Mai sends the tarpaulin quotation. Width three point two to four meters, for two leaking spots in the cutting section.
Number five. Trinh Do gives feedback on the GOH example sheet. Can outside workers follow it, and is there a simpler way.
Looking a little further. On Tuesday, the short-term salary payment, the machine rental list to Ian Kim, and the accounting team roles update.
Part three. Today's new expressions. Listen, then repeat.

The expression is pending. It means waiting for approval or a decision. For example, the PR for the emergency materials is still pending. Now say it with me. The PR for the emergency materials is still pending. ... ... ... One more time. The PR for the emergency materials is still pending. ... ... ...

The expression is finalize. It means to finish the changes and make the final version. For example, please finalize the September CMP file by Monday. Now say it with me. Please finalize the September CMP file by Monday. ... ... ... One more time. Please finalize the September CMP file by Monday. ... ... ...

The expression is justify. It means to give a good reason for a cost or a request. For example, please justify the purchase of three units. Now say it with me. Please justify the purchase of three units. ... ... ... One more time. Please justify the purchase of three units. ... ... ...

The expression is consistent. It means the same every time, following one rule. For example, keep the file name consistent every month. Now say it with me. Keep the file name consistent every month. ... ... ... One more time. Keep the file name consistent every month. ... ... ...

The expression is oversee. It means to watch a job on the floor and be responsible for it. For example, one packing staff will oversee the GOH box loading. Now say it with me. One packing staff will oversee the GOH box loading. ... ... ... One more time. One packing staff will oversee the GOH box loading. ... ... ...
Now three patterns.

The pattern is "Rather than something, please do something." Use it to correct a wrong method in a soft way. For example, rather than forwarding the email, please check it yourself. Now say it with me. Rather than forwarding the email, please check it yourself. ... ... ... One more time. Rather than forwarding the email, please check it yourself. ... ... ...

The pattern is "Please make sure that something." Use it to fix a rule or a condition. For example, please make sure the total formulas are not changed. Now say it with me. Please make sure the total formulas are not changed. ... ... ... One more time. Please make sure the total formulas are not changed. ... ... ...

The pattern is "Let's do this first, and then do that." Use it to agree on the order of work. For example, let's review the sheet together first, and then apply it on the floor. Now say it with me. Let's review the sheet together first, and then apply it on the floor. ... ... ... One more time. Let's review the sheet together first, and then apply it on the floor. ... ... ...
Part four. Role-play.
Here is a real situation for Monday morning. Hao comes to your desk about the machine rental list. Listen to the talk.
Anthony: Good morning, Hao. Did you see my two questions about the rental list?
Hao: Yes, Mr Lee. About the three computer sewing machines, the lines need them for the new style.
Anthony: I understand. But head office will ask why three. Please justify it with the style number and the line.
Hao: OK. And the price per unit is in the supplier's quotation. I will attach it.
Anthony: Good. And the return dates for the waistband machine and the chain double needle machine?
Hao: The waistband machine goes back in two weeks. The chain machine, about one week.
Anthony: Please write both dates in the reason column. From next month, please make sure the file name and the layout are consistent.
Hao: Understood. Should I send the file again today?
Anthony: Let's fix these two points first, and then I will send it to Ian Kim on Tuesday.
Now, let's practice two key sentences.
The first sentence. Please justify it with the style number and the line. ... ... ... One more time. Please justify it with the style number and the line. ... ... ...
The second sentence. Let's fix these two points first, and then I will send it on Tuesday. ... ... ... One more time. Let's fix these two points first, and then I will send it on Tuesday. ... ... ...
Great job.
Part five. Closing.

Here is the one thing to remember for Monday. Four people owe you something by Monday morning: Hao, Mai, Ms An, and Trinh Do. Check your inbox at eight, and send one short reminder to anyone who is late.
Have a restful Sunday, Anthony. See you tomorrow.
